Certain configurations of Alpine are affected. Other distros may be as well. The vulnerability exists in the interaction between OpenSSH, the code library implementing SSH connections, and musl, a lightweight alternative to the libc library that, unlike most other Linux distributions, is used in Alpine. Further, OpenSSH using musl (pronounced muscle) must not use PAM (pluggable authentication modules), a framework that handles user authentication and account-access checks. Alpine is a lightweight, widely used Linux distribution. Other platforms may be affected if they use the same configurations.

Explaining the Great Unconformity, where Cambrian deposits sit on top of older rocks. In a recent Nature study, Flament and his colleague Santosh Dhungana argue that this gap was carved with help from deep within the planet. According to their models, slow currents of hot rock in Earth’s mantle pushed entire continents up for hundreds of millions of years, letting glaciers grind them down and then let them sink, allowing fresh sediments to bury the scar. The largest hole in the rock record might be a fingerprint of processes happening deep in the planet’s interior.

Only 17 of the top 100 players in the 2027 draft class are set to have their eligibility expire Five-for-five plays out exactly how you think. College players have five years of service available to them before they've exhausted their NCAA eligibility, no matter whether they took a redshirt year or not. What this means is that true seniors, players who got on the field for four years without burning a redshirt, are no longer getting pushed out of the NCAA, but actually have another year of eligibility. I first got wind of this upcoming trend in October, so I decided to look at the upcoming class and how it would impact it. My finding: It could impact it a lot.

The No. 8 UCLA Bruins are headed to Minnesota for a date on Saturday against the Golden Gophers. UCLA has gone 1-3 all-time versus Minnesota. Saturday's game will be just the fifth meeting in the two program's history with the Bruins seeking for a change in their fortunes. Minnesota currently owns a 3-1 all-time advantage over UCLA including a win in the 1962 Rose Bowl. The 1962 Rose Bowl was the first-ever game between the Bruins and Golden Gophers and Minnesota traveled to Pasadena and knocked off UCLA 21-3 in the Rose Bowl. Over 60 years later, the two teams are now Big Ten Conference rivals, with the Week 10 matchup the second-ever conference showdown between the two schools.

(AP) — Logan O’Connor thinks of his late father in pregame warmup. He thinks of him sometimes in the middle of a game, too. His father, former NHL defenseman Myles O'Connor, died suddenly last month. It's the exact path, not the apparent severity that matters most, doctors say. Despite the ghastly injury, the man was alive and conscious when he arrived. He could still talk and move all four limbs. His doctors described him as being in a state of agitation. On the Glasgow Coma Scale, he scored a 12 (E3 V4 M5) , indicating a “moderate” brain injury, just one point above “mild.” He could open his left eye when told, but otherwise kept it closed (E3 score); he could talk and answer questions, but was confused (V4); and he intentionally moved away when pressure was applied to his body (M5).

Men's college soccer won't be a two-semester sport after all following a vote of Division I schools. Two-thirds of Division I schools rescinded a previously approved rule change to college soccer's calendar, the NCAA announced Friday, Nov. 6. The rule change would've moved the men's college soccer national championship to the spring semester; now, it will remain during the fall. The sport's oversight committee had previously adopted the rule change in May. Men's college soccer moving to a two-semester sport was also recommended by U.S. Soccer, the highest governing body in the country.

Experts say there could be more hikes over the next 18 months, as the conflict continues to push up food, fuel and energy prices across the UK and worldwide. Higher interest rates affect borrowing costs, however, which means mortgages, credit cards and personal loans could get more expensive for millions, even as savings rates improve.

The Leonid meteor shower, known for its bright and fast meteors, will kick off this weekend and continue until the end of November. The Leonid meteor shower is set to dazzle sky gazers across the UK throughout November. The celestial spectacle takes place from now until 30 November with the peak taking place on the night of 17 November. The shower is made up of dust particles from the Comet 55P/Tempel-Tuttle, which leaves a trail of debris as it follows its path around the Sun. These particles enter the Earth's atmosphere at up to 44 miles (71km) per second - meaning these streaks of light are the fastest meteors in the sky.

Wondering how rain-affected matches are decided in cricket? How the DLS method works in ODIs and T20Is, and how targets are adjusted fairly when weather interrupts play. The DLS method is used to determine fair targets in rain-affected limited-overs matches. The method is exclusively applied to limited-overs formats like ODIs and T20Is and is not used in Test cricket. Many matches, including World Cup games, have been decided by the DLS method, occasionally leading to significant debate. The method's name is derived from its creators Frank Duckworth and Tony Lewis, including the updated inputs from Steven Stern. Which is how the name, Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method was coined.

Downing Street says the prime minister will personally write to councils on Armistice Day to urge them to draw up plans. No one who served in the UK armed forces should have to sleep on the streets this Christmas, Andy Burnham has said. Downing Street said the prime minister will personally write to councils across England on Armistice Day (11 November) to urge them to draw up specific plans to offer accommodation for veterans sleeping rough ahead of the festive period. He will say that, going forward, national and local government should work under the "simple principle" that "no one who has served our country should ever be left to sleep rough on our streets".

Nintendo has released its remake of what is considered one of the best games ever made - the BBC's Tom Gerken gives his verdict. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time was finally released on Thursday, after years of rumours that Nintendo would remake the game - considered one of the best ever made. URI’s newcomers shined, six Rams hit double figures and Archie Miller’s team responded in its first taste of adversity in a 84-66 win over Monmouth. Monmouth trimmed a double-digit deficit to nine points midway through the second half, but Rhode Island answered the bell in emphatic fashion on its way to an 84-66 win in the Hall of Fame Tip-Off. Luter, a 5-foot-11, 203-pounder from Indianapolis, Ind., replaced Army starter Cale Hellums after the Black Knights , trailing 17-7, was ineffective. He hit a hole on the right side for 5 yards but was stopped just short from the 2. Hellums stepped back in and got the touchdown on the dive, cutting the margin to 17-14 with 6:07 left.

Smith, the best wideout in college football and a generational talent, is part of a descending Ohio State team that has just lost back-to-back games. After losing quarterback Julian Sayin to injury (possibly for the rest of the year), the team has started a slide that may send it out of the College Football Playoff picture. When the Saints host the Browns on Sunday, New Orleans defensive end Cam Jordan will reach a rare milestone. The Week 9 game will be Jordan's 250th. Via NBC Sports research, Jordan will become only the third defensive player in NFL history to play 250 or more games with the same team. The others are Darrell Green, who played 295 games for Washington from 1983 through 2002, and Jim Marshall, who played 270 games for the Vikings from 1961 through 1979. Jordan, the son of former Vikings tight end Steve Jordan, was a first-round pick in 2011. His dad played in 176 games from 1982 through 1994.

In response to Cooper Flagg being mentioned as the future face of the NBA, Villanueva countered - and then doubled down. The University of New Hampshire football team rallied in the final seconds to beat Rhode Island, 24-21. With UNH trailing 21-17 and 1:53 remaining, McLeish engineered an 11-play, 64-yard drive capped by a 1-yard touchdown pass to tight end Colby Ramshaw with 7 seconds remaining, giving the Wildcats a 24-21 lead. 'Like waking up on Christmas morning': Hawks complete championship run with victory in WIAA D2 state girls volleyball title match. The Hawks (31-11) beat Kettle Moraine Lutheran 25-21, 25-18, 20-25, 27-25 to capture their third title in program history, all coming in the last five years. Bella Daley had 12 kills and Kayla Fournillier added 10 to lead a balanced Hawks attack. Raya Zurfluh had 36 assists and Hope Kaufman and Rose Kendall had 15 and 14 digs, respectively. Lily Renz added four aces. Daley was in the Resch Center stands when the Hawks, led by her older sister Madison, captured back-to-back titles in 2022 and 2023.

Oregon football rode the momentum from a first-half fake punt to dominate Ohio State in Columbus. A season that seemed destined in the preseason for greatness was over before November. Fans were booing the Ducks ' offense, calling for heads to roll and fifth-year coach Dan Lanning had to figure out how to solve all of Oregon's issues while facing tough questions in his media appearances . A 41-28 win against Ohio State Nov. 7 in front of over 100,000 at Ohio Stadium was entirely different, to say the least. "Our goal was to quiet them down," Lanning said. "Then obviously in the fourth quarter, they weren't there anymore."

Angel Reese will never stop being trolled from her own celebration. Just before LSU fell, 31-13 to Alabama at Tiger Stadium, Reese was seen hanging out with her fellow LSU alumni, Shaquille O'Neal , and that's when he continued, what's been a recent tradition of trolling the former National Champion. His flesh bleached away to reveal the bones beneath, he wears stone axes on his head, elbows and knees, and wields a great band of lightning that runs from his ankles up, over his head. Namarrkon’s journey from the Arafura Sea to the Arnhem Land escarpment helped shape the landscape, according to the dreamtime stories of the Bininj. Police say more than 30 vehicles were involved in the incident on the M20 around 18:40 on Saturday. More than 30 vehicles were involved in a collision which left two people seriously injured on the M20 in Kent late on Saturday, police say. Officers were called to the scene at around 18:41 on the London-bound carriageway between junctions eight and nine, near Hollingbourne, Maidstone. Eleven people were cared for by paramedics and two taken to hospital, Kent Fire and Rescue Service said. An air ambulance crew, three fire engines and a "technical rescue unit" were sent to the scene, where National Highways said "thick fog" had been confirmed.

Shenendehowa (Division I) and Queensbury (Division II) secured team titles at the Section 2 girls' swimming championships at the Shenendehowa Aquatic Center. The Shenendehowa 400 freestyle relay team capped its victory by posting a winning time of 3 minutes, 39.17 seconds, edging out Niskayuna and Saratoga Springs. Overall, Shen tallied 427 points to easily prevail. "I think it was actually awesome," Shen freshman standout Lillian Hopke said. "Last year was a rough year. Our team motto this year was 'Set the standard.'"

Freshmen Jake Fette and Cardae Mack led Arizona State to a Big 12 victory over visiting Colorado before a sold-out crowd. Jake Fette made his home debut as a starter, and several others had starring roles as the Sun Devils surged past visiting Colorado 20-10 in front of another sellout crowd. Coach Kenny Dillingham's squad made it 10-0 thanks to a little trickery. On a fourth-and-goal at the 1, Cardae Mack took the snap and appeared trapped in the backfield, with a tackler around his ankles. He unleashed a toss to Fette, who was wide open in the end zone. The Sun Devils stayed in control from there.

Woodmont girls volleyball coach Haleigh Horgan's father died before the season started. Her team rallied around her and claimed its second state title. The Woodmont girls volleyball coach vividly recalled last season when the Wildcats defeated North Myrtle Beach in a five-set thriller to claim the school's first state championship in 47 years . Her father, Jimmy Gilbert, occupied that special spot in the bleachers. Before the season started, Gilbert died. And after Woodmont (42-2) defeated Wando (37-7) in four sets (19-25, 25-20, 25-22, 25-22) to win the SCHSL Class 5A state championship on Nov. 7 at Dreher High School, all Horgan could think about was how proud her father would be.

The Seahawks are making some last-minute adjustments to deal with several injuries ahead of Sunday’s game against the Arizona Cardinals. First, the defending Super Bowl champions signed Deven Eastern. Eastern, a rookie defensive tackle from Minnesota, has been a member of Seahawks' practice squad, and will play his first regular season game Sunday. With both Leonard Williams and Brandon Pili out Sunday, Eastern will likely see plenty of playing time. In addition to Eastern, the Seahawks are adding Bobby Hart and Montorie Foster Jr. to their roster from their practice squad for the Cardinals game.

ATLANTA (AP) — Tre Richardson totaled 101 all-purpose yards and scored two touchdowns and Louisville defeated Georgia Tech 44-17 at Bobby Dodd Stadium. The victory, Louisville's (6-3, 5-2 Atlantic Coast Conference), fourth in a row, clinched bowl eligibility for the sixth consecutive season. Quarterback Lincoln Kienholz completed first half touchdown passes to Tre Richardson and TreyShun Hurry, part of an efficient 17 of 25 passing performance with 182 passing yards and 81 rushing yards. Richardson added another score in the run game when he took an end around 52 yards to the end zone, and running back Isaac Brown picked up his 10th touchdown of the season on an 11-yard third quarter run.
